title: Service status and planned maintenance
summary: Check the current operational status of Service NSW services and planned maintenance.

faqs.q: How can I check if a Service NSW service is open?
faqs.a: You can check the current status of services on the Service NSW website.

faqs.q: Are there any planned maintenance periods?
faqs.a: The page provides information on planned maintenance for various services.

faqs.q: What should I do if a service is temporarily unavailable?
faqs.a: The page advises checking the status updates for the most current information.
